description: This file defines interfaces, configurations, and factory functions for upper PHY processing components in a 4G/5G radio system, including uplink/downlink processor factories, PHY layer configurations, and symbol handler factories.

classes.name: uplink_processor_factory
classes.description: Interface for creating uplink processors and validators.

classes.name: downlink_processor_factory
classes.description: Interface for creating downlink processors and validators.

classes.name: upper_phy_factory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating upper PHY objects.

classes.name: upper_phy_rx_symbol_handler_factory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating upper PHY receive symbol handlers.

classes.name: phy_tap_factory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating PHY layer taps.

methods.name: create_uplink_processor_pool
methods.description: Creates and returns a pool of uplink processors based on configuration.

methods.name: create_dl_processor_pool
methods.description: Creates and returns a pool of downlink processors based on configuration.

methods.name: create_downlink_processor_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a software-based downlink processor factory with specified configuration and dependencies.

methods.name: create_upper_phy_factory
methods.description: Creates and returns an upper PHY factory with specified configuration and dependencies.

methods.name: create_rx_symbol_handler_factory
methods.description: Creates a factory for upper PHY receive symbol handlers.

methods.name: create_rx_symbol_handler_printer_decorator_factory
methods.description: Creates a decorator factory for printing received symbols to a file.

methods.name: create_phy_tap_factory
methods.description: Creates a PHY layer tap factory with specified parameters.
